mapper.select:
select FINPROD_ID as hidCode, FINPROD_MARKET_ID as code , FINPROD_NAME as shortName from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1 and FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F10,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))

SELECT CALENDAR_ID as code, CALENDAR_NAME as name FROM MST_CALENDAR_INFO where 1=1
and CALENDAR_ID = #{tradeMarket,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodMarketId, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.BOARD as board, MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_NAME as customerName, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, FIN_PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, C.S_SHARES as sShares, C.C_SHARES as cShares, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE as mDate, FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE as vDate, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY as ccy, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.SH_OR_ZH as shOrZh, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.IS_MARGIN_FINPROD as isMarginFinprod FROM FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO ON FIN_PRODUCT.ISSUER = MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE A WHERE DEAL_DATE IN ( SELECT MAX (DEAL_DATE) FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE b WHERE A .SHARES_ID = b.SHARES_ID AND to_char(DEAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') < #{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY SHARES_ID ) ORDER BY SHARES_ID ) C ON C.SHARES_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID where 1=1 and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F10,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT CUSTOMER_ID code,CUSTOMER_NAME name,CUSTOMER_NAME shortName,CUSTOMER_ID hidCode FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO

SELECT C.S_SHARES as sShares, C.C_SHARES as cShares from ( SELECT * FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE A WHERE DEAL_DATE IN ( SELECT MAX (DEAL_DATE) FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE b WHERE A .SHARES_ID = b.SHARES_ID AND to_char(DEAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') < #{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY SHARES_ID ) ORDER BY SHARES_ID ) C
and C.SHARES_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT REAL_NAME realName FROM SYS_USER
USER_NAME = #{userName}
